title: 第5章 孩子们是团宠
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
蔡老太第一眼就搁心里嘀咕，这种户型在后世妥妥的一室一厅。

    原本当客厅的地方布置成了一居室，大立柜，写字台，木床，四条腿的餐桌，条凳都已经添置上了。

    应该都是新打的，还没来得及上清漆，摸着还有点刺挠。

    这要是在城里头，得有钱有票有工业券，三样东西配备齐全也才能买一个衣柜，这居然都有了。

    赵玉兰心情总算舒坦些了，但她不好意思和丈夫说笑，扭头高高兴兴喊：“妈，你看这床，得有一米八吧！咱邻居家结婚的时候，等了一年才等来个家具厂的批条，去家具厂也是买这么大的床，听说花了四十多块钱，咱家自己打的反而更好看。”

    边上的魏建业时刻找机会偷瞄媳妇。

    老魏家房子吃紧，以往都是赵玉兰领着孩子们跟蔡老太住一屋。

    老魏头去和没结婚的小儿子住一屋。

    魏建业只要一回家就会领着赵玉兰拿着结婚证去住招待所。

    那地儿的房门钥匙都插钥匙扣里，有规定不能锁门，方便招待所职工随时来检查，所以夫妻俩白天也不敢太亲密，晚上黑灯瞎火才敢造娃娃，彼此不太熟啊。

    他也看着蔡老太，回的却是媳妇的话，“妈，这床确实是一米八的，海岛上抗风桐多，想做啥家具都有，不够再说！”

    赵玉兰兴致勃勃地追问：“妈，什么是抗风桐啊，你听说过没啊？”

    魏建业笑呵呵地说：

    “妈，其实就是泡桐树，咱老家门口不也有一棵么，开花的时候就是紫色的小花，我小时候爬上爬下的揪来吸蜜呢。”

    “等会我领你们去看看老家没有的椰子树，给你们摘几个椰子喝，这里过年的时候还拿椰子煮鸡汤，回头说什么都得让你们吃上一回。”

    三孩子已经跑次卧参观去了，也在抢蔡老太，一直喊着：“奶奶，奶奶你快看!”

    蔡老太往次卧去，走两步就回头喝住亦步亦趋跟上来的夫妻俩，问：“咋的，你们夫妻俩打算一辈子都拿我当挡箭牌啊？”

    她自己进的小房间，目测也是三十平米左右，实打实的东屋。

    屋里头也有一张一米五的木床，还有一张折叠起来的行军床，也用泡桐木打了个木头柜子。

    房间还多开了个后门，还有一间几平方米的小屋，瞅着应该是灶房，但还没有垒灶台，瞧着没一丝人气。

    后院空地挺大的，蔡老太背着手绕着空地踱步。

    夫妻俩到底还是跟了过来，情不自禁地也跟在蔡老太身后。
content_en:
At the first sight, Mrs. Cai muttered to herself that this type of apartment would be suitable for one bedroom and one living room in later generations.

The place that was originally the living room has been turned into a one-bedroom apartment. A large standing cabinet, a writing desk, a wooden bed, a four-legged dining table, and a bench have all been added.

They should all be newly painted. They haven't had time to apply varnish yet, and they are still a little prickly when touched.

If you were in the city, you would have to have money, tickets, industrial coupons, and all three things to buy a wardrobe, but here you have it.

Zhao Yulan finally felt better, but she was too embarrassed to joke with her husband. She turned around and shouted happily: "Mom, look at this bed, it must be 1.8 meters! When our neighbor got married, we waited for a year for approval from the furniture factory. We also bought such a big bed from the furniture factory. I heard that it cost more than 40 yuan, but the one we made ourselves looks better."

Wei Jianye beside him was always looking for opportunities to peek at his wife.

The old Wei family's house was in short supply, so in the past, Zhao Yulan led the children to live in the same room as Mrs. Cai.

Old Wei went to live in the same house with his unmarried younger son.

As soon as Wei Jianye returns home, he will take Zhao Yulan to a guest house with his marriage certificate.

The door keys there were all put into the keychain, and there was a rule that the door could not be locked, so that the guest house staff could come and check at any time. Therefore, the couple did not dare to get too close during the day, and only dared to make dolls in the dark at night. They were not very familiar with each other.

He also looked at Mrs. Cai, but what he replied was his wife's words, "Mom, this bed is indeed 1.8 meters tall. There are many wind-resistant tung trees on the island. We have all the furniture you want, so don't worry if it's not enough!"

Zhao Yulan asked enthusiastically: "Mom, what is Kangfengtong? Have you heard of it?"

Wei Jianye said with a smile:

"Mom, it's actually a paulownia tree. Isn't there one at the door of our hometown? When it blooms, it turns into small purple flowers. When I was a child, I climbed up and down to grab the honey."

"I'll take you to see the coconut trees that don't exist in my hometown later. I'll pick some coconuts for you to drink. During the Chinese New Year, we even use coconuts to make chicken soup. I'll let you eat whatever I want later."

The three children had already gone to visit the second bedroom, and they were also trying to grab Mrs. Cai. They kept shouting: "Grandma, grandma, look!"

Mrs. Cai went to the second bedroom. After taking two steps, she turned back to stop the couple who were following them step by step. She asked, "What, you two are going to use me as a shield for the rest of your life?"

The small room she entered by herself was about thirty square meters by visual inspection, and it was a real east room.

There is also a 1.5-meter wooden bed in the house, a folding camp bed, and a wooden cabinet made of paulownia wood.

The room also has an extra back door, and a small room of a few square meters. It looks like it should be a stove, but there is no stove, so it doesn't look popular at all.

There was a large open space in the backyard, and Mrs. Cai was pacing around the open space with her hands behind her back.

The couple finally followed, and couldn't help but follow behind Mrs. Cai.
